visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black beret and a black sweatshirt opens a pink restroom stall door and looks directly at the camera with an exaggerated expression of disgust. The background shows a simple, slightly aged indoor hallway. (2) The camera cuts to a top-down view of a squat toilet within a tiled stall; the toilet contains un-flushed brown waste. (3) In a men's restroom, a man in a black shirt uses a urinal while another man in a white sweatshirt walks in and stands at the adjacent urinal despite others being free. (4) A girl wearing a dark hoodie and glasses enters a restroom area; the grey tiled floor is covered in visible puddles of water. (5) The man in the beret exits a stall while pinching his nose and waving his hand to dissipate an invisible smell. (6) A man carrying several colorful shopping bags enters a stall, looks at the door for a hook, finds none, and tries to manage the bags while undressing. (7) A person with glasses is seen through a wide vertical gap in a restroom door, looking out with a concerned expression. (8) A girl washes her hands in a sink where a pink basketball and a green spray can are oddly placed on the counter. (9) A person with long hair wearing a pink checkered dress (Mei-jie) appears against an animated fire explosion background, gesturing aggressively and pointing at the viewer. (10) Mei-jie tours a modern, brightly lit restroom featuring clean white sinks, wooden doors with accessible handles, and clear gender-neutral signage. (11) Visual charts and text overlays appear showing the Ministry of Education logo and statistics regarding restroom improvements as Mei-jie poses energetically in various clean stalls.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy, upbeat electronic music begins with a strong kick drum. A male voice shouts an introduction with extreme excitement and high pitch. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect transitions into a sequence of comedic sound bites. (3) Each point of the 'bad bathroom' list is punctuated by a cartoonish 'pop' or 'ding' sound. The narrator's speech rate is incredibly fast, maintaining high arousal. (4) A loud explosion SFX occurs as the character 'Mei-jie' appears, followed by a swelling synthesizer riser. (5) As modern restroom features are showcased, bright 'sparkle' SFX and positive chimes are heard over the continuous high-tempo EDM track. (6) The video concludes with a heavy drum hit and a final enthusiastic vocal slogan.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based -> Hook -> Evidence -> CTA: The video first lists common restroom annoyances to build empathy, introduces a persona as a 'hook', showcases improved facilities as evidence of change, and ends with a promotional message for a government project.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a high-energy advertisement for the Ministry of Education in Taiwan, specifically promoting the 'School Restroom Improvement Project'. It uses humor and exaggerated social scenarios to contrast the 'old and dirty' image of school toilets with the newly renovated, modern, and inclusive facilities currently being implemented across the country.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of government logos, project statistics, and verbal promotion of the Ministry of Education's initiatives.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses short-form social media editing tropes (fast cuts, loud SFX, variety subtitles) to make government messaging more engaging for a younger audience.
